title: allionia pilosa
intro: Allionia pilosa, commonly known as False or Mexican Jasmine, is a plant species native to Mexico and parts of Central America. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its use in treating coughs and colds due to its expectorant properties, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. Allionia pilosa is also reported to have therapeutic actions such as being an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential benefits.
